passages.text: Hallelujah! Praise the LORD from the heavens; praise Him in the highest places.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
He is in the heavens.
Praise the LORD.
Praise Him from the heavens.
Praise Him in the highest places.
Hallelujah!
passages.original: הַ֥לְלוּ יָ֨הּ׀ הַֽלְל֣וּ אֶת־ יְ֭הוָה מִן־ הַשָּׁמַ֑יִם הַֽ֝לְל֗וּהוּ בַּמְּרוֹמִֽים׃

passages.text: Praise Him, all His angels; praise Him, all His heavenly hosts.
passages.sermon:
God is the subject.
God deserves praise.
All His angels must praise Him.
All His heavenly hosts must praise Him.
passages.original: הַֽלְל֥וּהוּ כָל־ מַלְאָכָ֑יו הַֽ֝לְל֗וּהוּ כָּל־ צְבָאוֹ׃

passages.text: Praise Him, O sun and moon; praise Him, all you shining stars.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the one true God.
He deserves praise.
Sun, praise the LORD.
Moon, praise the LORD.
All shining stars, praise the LORD.
passages.original: הַֽ֭לְלוּהוּ שֶׁ֣מֶשׁ וְיָרֵ֑חַ הַ֝לְל֗וּהוּ כָּל־ כּ֥וֹכְבֵי אֽוֹר׃

passages.text: Praise Him, O highest heavens, and you waters above the skies.
passages.sermon:
The highest heavens exist above the earth.
The waters above the skies exist above the earth.
The highest heavens must praise the LORD.
The waters above the skies must praise the LORD.
passages.original: הַֽ֭לְלוּהוּ שְׁמֵ֣י הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם וְ֝הַמַּ֗יִם אֲשֶׁ֤ר׀ מֵעַ֬ל הַשָּׁמָֽיִם׃

passages.text: Let them praise the name of the LORD, for He gave the command and they were created.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
The LORD has a name.
His name is holy.
Let all things praise the name of the LORD.
The LORD gave a command.
He spoke with authority.
All things were created by His command.
He made everything by His word.
passages.original: יְֽ֭הַֽלְלוּ אֶת־ שֵׁ֣ם יְהוָ֑ה כִּ֤י ה֭וּא צִוָּ֣ה וְנִבְרָֽאוּ׃

passages.text: He established them forever and ever; He issued a decree that will never pass away.
passages.sermon:
God created the heavens and the waters above the skies.
God established the heavens and the waters above the skies.
God made them last forever and ever.
God gave a command for them.
God’s command will never end.
God’s decree will never be broken.
passages.original: וַיַּעֲמִידֵ֣ם לָעַ֣ד לְעוֹלָ֑ם חָק־ נָ֝תַ֗ן וְלֹ֣א יַעֲבֽוֹר׃

passages.text: Praise the LORD from the earth, all great sea creatures and ocean depths, lightning and hail, snow and clouds, powerful wind fulfilling His word, mountains and all hills, fruit trees and all cedars, wild animals and all cattle, crawling creatures and flying birds, kings of the earth and all peoples, princes and all rulers of the earth, young men and maidens, old and young together.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
He deserves praise from all creation on earth.
Great sea creatures must praise the LORD.
All the ocean depths must praise Him.
Lightning must praise the LORD.
Hail must praise Him.
Snow must praise the LORD.
Clouds must praise Him.
Powerful wind must praise the LORD.
The wind does what God commands.
Mountains must praise the LORD.
All hills must praise Him.
Fruit trees must praise the LORD.
All cedars must praise Him.
Wild animals must praise the LORD.
All cattle must praise Him.
Crawling creatures must praise the LORD.
Flying birds must praise Him.
Kings of the earth must praise the LORD.
All peoples must praise Him.
Princes must praise the LORD.
All rulers of the earth must praise Him.
Young men must praise the LORD.
Maidens must praise Him.
Old people must praise the LORD.
Young people must praise Him.
All must praise the LORD together.
passages.original: הַֽלְל֣וּ אֶת־ יְ֭הוָה מִן־ הָאָ֑רֶץ תַּ֝נִּינִ֗ים וְכָל־ תְּהֹמֽוֹת׃ אֵ֣שׁ וּ֭בָרָד שֶׁ֣לֶג וְקִיט֑וֹר ר֥וּחַ סְ֝עָרָ֗ה עֹשָׂ֥ה דְבָרֽוֹ׃ הֶהָרִ֥ים וְכָל־ גְּבָע֑וֹת עֵ֥ץ פְּ֝רִ֗י וְכָל־ אֲרָזִֽים׃ הַֽחַיָּ֥ה וְכָל־ בְּהֵמָ֑ה רֶ֝֗מֶשׂ וְצִפּ֥וֹר כָּנָֽף׃ מַלְכֵי־ אֶ֭רֶץ וְכָל־ לְאֻמִּ֑ים שָׂ֝רִ֗ים וְכָל־ שֹׁ֥פְטֵי אָֽרֶץ׃ בַּחוּרִ֥ים וְגַם־ בְּתוּל֑וֹת זְ֝קֵנִ֗ים עִם־ נְעָרִֽים׃

passages.text: Let them praise the name of the LORD, for His name alone is exalted; His splendor is above the earth and the heavens.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
His name is the LORD.
His name is above every other name.
Only His name is exalted.
His splendor is greater than the earth.
His splendor is greater than the heavens.
Let all praise the name of the LORD.
passages.original: יְהַלְל֤וּ׀ אֶת־ שֵׁ֬ם יְהוָ֗ה כִּֽי־ נִשְׂגָּ֣ב שְׁמ֣וֹ לְבַדּ֑וֹ ה֝וֹד֗וֹ עַל־ אֶ֥רֶץ וְשָׁמָֽיִם׃

passages.text: He has raised up a horn for His people, the praise of all His saints, of Israel, a people near to Him. Hallelujah!
passages.sermon:
God acts with power for His people.
He lifts up strength for them.
He gives honor to all His faithful ones.
He gives praise to the people of Israel.
Israel is a people close to God.
Praise the LORD!
passages.original: וַיָּ֤רֶם קֶ֨רֶן׀ לְעַמּ֡וֹ תְּהִלָּ֤ה לְֽכָל־ חֲסִידָ֗יו לִבְנֵ֣י יִ֭שְׂרָאֵל עַֽם־ קְרֹב֗וֹ הַֽלְלוּ־ יָֽהּ׃
